name: Oikawa Madoka
source:
Maiden name: Hayamizu Madoka
She is married to the protagonist, and they live a double income life.
She and the protagonist were in the same seminar during their college days, began dating after a certain event and ended up getting married.

Cool and dependable Wife.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1161863]Getchu[/url]]
